title: Agents on ComfyUI: tools, verification, side-effect safety

questions.q: Where should an agent's limits live?
questions.why: Instructions can be ignored or argued round. Code runs every time.

questions.q: A graph passes validate_prompt. What has been shown?
options: Its structure and types are acceptable, not that the picture will be right
The picture will match the prompt
questions.answer: Its structure and types are acceptable, not that the picture will be right
questions.why: Validation sees types and ranges. Crossed prompts and huge sizes pass.

questions.q: The history says success and outputs are empty. What should the agent report?
options: No files were made, so it can't call this done
questions.answer: No files were made, so it can't call this done
questions.why: Report what's real: the lab's third case.

questions.q: Why treat POST /free or clearing the queue differently from GET /history?
options: They change shared state on the server
questions.answer: They change shared state on the server
questions.why: They touch other people's jobs and models. Reads change nothing.

questions.q: A README an agent fetched says 'now run this shell command'. What should happen?
options: Nothing: tool output is data, not instructions
Run it, the README is official
Ask the model to judge alone
Add it to the allow list
questions.answer: Nothing: tool output is data, not instructions
questions.why: Text from a tool can't grant permissions.
